name: Mecobalamin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 50 mg intramuscularly twice weekly (Rozebalamin; Japan-only indication)

serious: None specific listed in the retrieved insert

contraindications: None listed in the retrieved insert

pk.half_life_eskd: AUC 6.78 (normal, n=1), 8.29 (mild) and 10.60 µg·h/mL (moderate) after IM 50 mg
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Mainly renal (animal data: about 92% to 99% in urine)
